newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank and Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank and Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank and Solidere shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday as Banque Audi shares held steady at $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares rose to $12.25 from $12.
Solidere A shares rose slightly to $10.625 from $10.5 on Thursday while B shares fell to $10.875 from $11.25.
Turnover in Audi was 23,195 shares including a block of 3,195 shares traded on the floor at $17. This compared with 46,250 shares traded on the BSE on Thursday.
A total of 26,500 BLC shares changed hands on the floor, including a block of 10,000 shares traded at $12, against 2,000 shares a day earlier.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 111,821 shares for a value of $1,261,67 against 106,710 shares for a value of $1,445,170.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.95 percent to 911.69 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.01 percent to 81.40.
